{{Top|leg}}
A '''viewvid''' was a user-operated system aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It could be used to access the ship's [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]], view other areas of the ship&mdash;excluding the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], engineering deck, and staterooms&mdash;deck plans, ship's itinerary, and a passenger directory.
